admission.justification: Verified undo and honest partial-publication reporting prevent a failed file write from concealing surviving product changes or an already-raised task question.

applicability: Validated converted-memory file publication encountering an OSError before all replacements and deletions finish, and the resulting Writer refusal report.
conditions: Capture the live original bytes or absence for every intended affected path before changing files; after an OSError attempt every recorded independent restoration, remove creations and clean the temporary staging file.
Verify the surviving bytes/absence and retain every restore, verification or cleanup failure; never equate an incomplete or unverifiable rollback with a successful undo.
A refusal distinguishes verified restoration from incomplete/unverifiable rollback and preserves honest notice of raise questions already published before memory-file failure.
exclusions: Rollback covers the memory files this operation changed, not an already-published task-document question or a Git/ref transaction.
No crash durability, arbitrary non-OSError recovery, disk-failure immunity or promise that a retry must succeed; source examination is not execution/acceptance evidence.
statement: A partial memory-file write failure must restore replaced or deleted files, remove creations, and report any unverified restoration or already-published question honestly.
